keyRenameNote: PLAN-48 (P-6): stored keys were '{packId}:{ruleKey}', which fails PLAN-47's key pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9:-]{2,99}$ (lower case); they are now 'MOF:{ruleKey}'.
scopeNote: PLAN-49 (D-POL-1, D-POL-4): the pack used to ask for evidence on annual leave (Contracts.Leave, RequireEvidence, key R-FIN-LEAVE-NOTE). No call site of Contracts.Leave consumes that effect, so the domain catalog refuses it. The pack now holds a rule the catalog accepts, the ceiling allows (it only adds a constraint) and a call site consumes: proof of handover on every custody assignment.
